name: Play a modal double-faced land face on turn 1-2 when no ordinary land is in hand
intent: On turn 1 or 2, with no ordinary land at all in hand but a modal double-faced card's land face available (Sink into Stupor // Soporific Springs), play that land face instead of holding both halves back - the land drop is otherwise wasted entirely. Declines the land face's own 3-life payment (it reads 'you may pay 3 life', unlike a shockland's 2): a tapped land costs no tempo this turn either way, so there is nothing this turn's life buys. Stands down against this deck's own aggro matchups (45c-aggro, boros-aggro, boros-energy, ur-cutter-prowess) - against a fast clock, spending the land drop on a card that is otherwise a real spell (Sink into Stupor bounces a permanent) is worth more held back than a tapped land is, so the seat keeps the choice there instead. The false list also repeats U/P/F's own true-count keys (already logically unreachable here, since each of them requires a Land in hand and this play's own true already requires zero) so the plays-check lint can see the exclusivity syntactically rather than needing subset reasoning across differently-shaped selects. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack.
